label: rem:regime-table
title: Master regime table for the substrate parameter $q$
html:
All quantitative regime claims in this chapter and Chapter 9 unify into a single table. Per-section tables covering operational entropy, information speed of light, gravitational constant, and Hausdorff dimension recurrence are direct projections of this master table to relevant rows.

Regime q \hbar_q c_q \eta_q d_H(q) G_q Description
Classical limit q \to 1^+ \to 0 \to \infty \to 1 \to 1 \to G_{\mathrm{Newton}} Spatial coupling instantaneous; classical PDEs recovered; Julia set = unit circle
The observed universe q_0 \approx 1.110 \approx 0.0991 \approx 9.093 \approx 0.892 \approx 1.088 numerical (Planck-normalised) Moderate quantum: \sim 9 fibres correlated per Reeb advance; {\sim}0.89 q-bits per Planck step
Golden crossover q = q_{\mathrm{gold}} = 1/\varphi^{2} -\varphi -\varphi (sign flip) (degenerate node) (degenerate) Reeb-weight sign flip; Descartes elliptic curve degenerates to nodal \mathbb{P}^{1}
Deep quantum / Big Bang q \to \infty \to 1 \to 0 \to 0 \to 0 \to 0 No spatial propagation; fibres isolated; Julia set collapses; zero information per step

Reading the table. The quantum Planck constant is \hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1} (quantum Planck constant). The information speed of light is c_q = 1/(q-1) (information speed of light). The operational entropy evaluates to \eta_q = (2q-1)/q^{3} (operational entropy). The Julia-set Hausdorff dimension is d_H(q) = (2q-1)^{2}/q^{3} (Hausdorff dimension recurrence). The parameter G_q denotes the gravitational constant in Planck-normalised units (gravitational constant). It varies with q across the table, satisfying G_{\mathrm{Planck}} = 1 exactly at q = q_0.

Observational caveat. The dispersive variables \hbar_q and c_q apply strictly at the substrate level. Any residual q-dispersion affecting archimedean photon propagation is tightly constrained by gamma-ray-burst time-of-flight measurements [abdo2009]. These bounds are comprehensively surveyed in the Planck-scale phenomenology literature [amelinocamelia2013]. The necessary theoretical suppression mechanism is recorded in the DSR remark and the suppression-scale conjecture.

Use. Downstream regime summaries project the relevant rows of this master table rather than reproducing independent values; any newly derived regime quantity adds a column here.
